tasks.spec: ## Repository: api, check-write routes for database-only ids and the transactional reconcile; Required behavior 1-6 and 28-32 for check writes (without keep markers and without precedence); counterexamples 15, 20, 21, 24 (check part) and 36; Checks 1a and 1d, the revision part of Check 2 and the write portion of Check 3. Build on them. Record Checks 1a (POST on a read-only file returns 201 and probes receive the literal definition) and 1d (broken bytes stay unchanged after POST 201 with the fresh revision) as red on baseline 2bc5910 for the specified behavioral reasons, not import or type errors, then make them green. Move POST/PUT/DELETE of /admin/checks from src/config-write.ts to a new src/check-write.ts, rewire src/admin-routes.ts and share the writer lock. Preserve exact status order, ETag, Location, audit actions, metrics and safe messages of items 8-18; absent ids 404, stale or racing writes 412, a source field in the body 422 (counterexample 15). Commit the definition, generation +1, upsertChecks and the audit entry in one SQLite transaction; every committed check write advances the generation by exactly 1. Change the service reconcile so it can join the caller's transaction, with the exact service removal log text from Contract fields; publish holder and cache changes and effects only after commit, so a rollback leaves every SQL row, audit entry, revision and in-memory state unchanged (injected failure of the audit insert is 500, counterexample 36). Publish the stored definitions to the holder at write time by merging them with the currently applied file checks through effectiveChecks, and load stored definitions into the holder at startup after the file is applied; the startup order stays file first and unchanged in this task, and the precedence rules (id collisions with file ids, file-only ids read-only, shadowed entries, SIGHUP/adopt keeping database checks) are T4, so T2 tests use ids that the file does not contain. The admin revision is 'sha256-' plus the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the UTF-8 '<applied file revision>\n<database generation>' (one newline); invalid, unreadable or pending file bytes do not change it; every following write needs its success ETag or a freshly fetched revision, and the first of two concurrent PUTs with the same If-Match is 200 and the second 412 (counterexample 21); a broken file does not block a database write, which returns 201 with the fresh revision and leaves the bytes unchanged (counterexample 20); database check writes never return 503 and never touch the file (counterexample 24, check part). Keep markers, heartbeat secret retain/rotate and materialized validation are T3; this task treats field values as given, accepts plaintext heartbeat secrets only as digests and rejects marker objects with 422 until T3 implements them. If admin-created checks are already stored in the database at task start, obey the section's needs-input condition. Use temp databases/127.0.0.1:0, injected clock/reloads and typed contract-validated responses.
